en_mt.title: Rescuers have eliminated the consequences of the Russian shelling
en_mt.body: In the Golosiivskyi district of the capital, a fire broke out in a non-residential building as a result of the hit. At another address, on open terrain, fragments of an enemy UAV were burning. Fortunately, there are no dead or injured. Currently, all fires have been extinguished. Site • Fb • X • IG • YT • TT

en_mt.body: On 23 November, Russians killed 2 residents of Donetchyna: in Kramatorsk. Another 5 people in the region received injuries over the day. The total number of Russian victims in Donetchyna is given without taking into account Mariupol and Volnovakha.
